en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Trimming the nails on the day of Friday is a safety from the leprosy, and the vitiligo, and the blindness, and if you do not need to, so file it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ’
Clipping fingernails on Fridays is immunity from leprosy, albinism and blindness. If you do not need clipping then just scratch them.’”
